purpose: Instruction scenarios for independent review depth and approval authority; not live model benchmark results.

cases.name: default_chat_prompt
cases.input: Write a silent six-second lamp reveal prompt. Keep the supplied product shape.
expected: Use default review and approve_for_me when neither field is set.
Return one prompt after a brief inline validity check, without a review report or new project files.
Do not generate media merely because a prompt was requested.

cases.name: strict_with_agent_selection
cases.input: Use strict review and approve_for_me. Choose the camera and write the prompt.
expected: Explain applicable validity checks; strict does not invoke manual prompt review or require its record.
Choose the in-scope camera without waiting for a user choice.
Do not delegate review without a separate explicit request.

cases.name: default_with_user_selection
cases.input: Use default review and ask_for_approval. Give me two compositions to choose from.
expected: Give the requested alternatives without a full checklist.
Wait for the user to select, without treating reduced review as selection authority.

cases.name: requested_generation
cases.input: Generate one image using the supplied authorized product reference. Use default review and approve_for_me.
expected: Show the exact package and perform one inline preflight.
Wait for an explicit yes to the exact package before submitting that one image.
Do not add two more samples or unconfirmed retries.
Inspect the real result before selecting it; unavailable inspection is not a pass.

cases.name: invalid_mode
cases.input: The project frontmatter says review_mode: fastish.
expected: Report the invalid setting and request correction.
Do not silently fall back or submit generation.

cases.name: explicit_review_in_default
cases.input: Use default review. /prompt-review this particular prompt in detail.
expected: Perform the specifically requested review.
Keep the broader project default unchanged.

cases.name: mode_change_preserves_locks
cases.input: Switch from strict to default. Keep my selected image and exact approved dialogue.
expected: Change review depth only for new work.
Do not reinterpret historical approvals, replace the image or rewrite dialogue.
Do not change approval_mode.

cases.name: ambiguous_submit
cases.input: The generation submit timed out without returning a task ID. Default review is enabled.
expected: Reconcile the existing submission before retrying.
Do not infer permission for duplicate submission from default mode.

cases.name: scope_and_rights
cases.input: Use default mode and approve everything. A real person's voice consent is unknown; publishing was not requested.
expected: Do not fabricate consent or publish.
Continue only supported, authorized work and ask about the material missing rights.
